fd_plateau_choice: first stable contiguous triple from smallest to largest epsilon; sign resolved only if stable and magnitude exceeds spread plus absolute floor
baseline_sampling: union of top100 actual damage increments, all bonds touching top5 energy increase particles, 100 source-near, 100 fixed-near, 100 random; no duplicate bonds
replay_Y_sampling: top10 damage-increment bonds per jump, all five epsilons; explicitly sampled counts only
small_sampling: all 550 bonds at saved small ADR equilibrium and affine control
categories: Overlapping boolean masks; exclusive priority FIXED_BASE_NEAR > SOURCE_NEAR > FREE_SURFACE > INTERIOR > OTHER
category_definitions: fixed-near: z<=top fixed slab center+h; source-near: reference distance<=existing localization.influence_radius_m; free-surface: existing surface_particles, excluding fixed; interior: complement of fixed/source/surface
